pattern: Pattern B — Mixed hosting: some App Service, some Static Web Apps
evidence: Publishing production hostnames are bound to app-jm1-pub-prod App Service and its GitHub workflow deploys standalone Next output to App Service with staging slot promotion.
J Merrill One, Financial, Foundation, Productions, and Jackie production hostnames are bound to Static Web Apps and their current production workflows use Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1.
No Azure Front Door, Traffic Manager, or Application Gateway resources were found for the scoped public sites.
recommendedArchitectureAtHost01: KEEP CURRENT MIXED HOSTING; RETAIN SWA WHERE TECHNICALLY APPROPRIATE; retain Publishing on App Service because it has dynamic/runtime and integration requirements.
